77656.subject: 🔷 The Daily: Wall Street giant Citi is getting into bitcoin custody
77656.body:
Metaplanet takes 96% of Super League in bitcoin-and-cash deal to launch US bitcoin treasury firm | Kraken brings US stock trading to European Economic Area customers | Ripple partners with South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank for cross-border payments | Curve founder says FATF pressure could make DeFi safer and more decentralized |

The Daily ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by James Hunt | Edited by Jason Shubnell

Presented by:

JPEG Trading ( https://x.com/jpegtrading?lang=en&utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Happy Tuesday! *Bitcoin's* prolonged volatility squeeze increasingly favors an upside break as the foremost cryptocurrency heads back toward $65,000, according to *Bitfinex* analysts, though they said a sustained move may depend on spot ETF inflows and stablecoin liquidity returning.

In today's newsletter, *Citi* gets set to launch *bitcoin* custody, *Metaplanet* takes a 96% stake in *Super League Entertainment* , *Kraken* brings U.S. stock trading to the *EEA* , and more.

Meanwhile, " *The Crypto Program* " promoter *Edward Zimbardi* was deported ( https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-08-18-the-crypto-program-promoter-deported-from-fiji-over-alleged-165-million-ponzi-scheme-412083?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) from Fiji to face charges in the U.S. over an alleged $165 million Ponzi scheme.

*👀 P.S.* Don't forget to check out today's reader poll on *Trump's meeting with crypto executives* later in the newsletter.

*⛰️ Reminder:* We're on the ground at *SALT's Blockchain Symposium* ( https://www.salt.org/events/wyoming-blockchain-symposium-2026?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) in Jackson Hole Aug. 17-20, with exclusive interviews and coverage of the biggest stories shaping crypto and global finance.

*THE BIG ONE*

*🏦 Citi expects to launch bitcoin custody later this year under its new Custody+ platform*

( https://www.theblock.co/news/business/2026-08-18-citi-bitcoin-custody-412090?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

*Citi* is set to launch its digital asset custody service later this year, starting with *bitcoin* , as part of its new *Custody+* platform.

* The bank had previously disclosed plans for native crypto custody in November, with Tuesday's announcement confirming a 2026 rollout and bitcoin named as the first supported asset.
* Clients will be able to hold both traditional and crypto assets within the same framework, built on Citi's common digital asset architecture, the firm said.
* Citi said Custody+ is designed for markets moving toward continuous trading and shorter settlement cycles, including real-time asset servicing, instant settlements, liquidity tools, and AI-driven market intelligence.

77643.subject: Ionian Cruises - Cancellation Cruise
77643.body:
Dear Guest,

We would like to inform you that due to unforeseen operational
circumstances, we are unfortunately unable to operate your scheduled
excursion tomorrow to Paxos & Antipaxos.

As a result, your excursion will need to be cancelled.

Please contact the booking platform through which you made your
reservation and request the cancellation and full refund. We will also
contact the platform from our side to confirm the cancellation, so that
your booking can be cancelled and your refund processed accordingly.

We sincerely apologise for this unexpected change and for any
inconvenience it may cause to your plans.

Thank you very much for your understanding.

Kind regards,
Ionian Cruises team
